facts.business: Alphalogic Techsys Limited is primarily engaged in the information technology business and has diversified into an ethanol manufacturing business, while its subsidiary Alphalogic Industries is engaged in manufacturing of industrial racking and storage systems along with allied steel fabrication activities.

auditor.name: Patki & Soman, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on Note 32 regarding contingent liabilities; opinion not modified in respect of this matter.

key_risks: Capitalization of borrowing costs and valuation of Capital Work-in-Progress (CWIP) for the ethanol manufacturing project involves significant management judgement and estimation.
Revenue recognition cut-off risk for the Group.
Inventory valuation risk for the subsidiary due to commodity price volatility of steel and steel-related products.
